name: 86 Chaos 17.1.9
label: 86 Chaos 17.1.9
notes: The mobile Voice toolbar button now opens the 86Voice command panel first and never starts recording before the panel is visible.
Microphone capture starts only from the explicit Start Listening control inside 86Voice, with status and errors kept visible in the panel.
Server transcription no longer inherits the general VOICE_GEMINI_MODEL and defaults to the current audio-capable gemini-3.5-flash-lite model.
Provider rejection diagnostics now record the model, status, MIME type, audio size, and a safe provider message without exposing credentials.
Legacy Gemini 2.5 voice model overrides are automatically migrated to the current 3.5 Flash-Lite voice path so stale Vercel configuration cannot force a 404.
title: 86 Chaos 17.1.9
summary: Makes 86Voice panel-first and separates microphone transcription from legacy voice-intent model configuration.
description: Repairs the mobile voice interaction order so the 86Voice controller is always visible before capture starts, keeps errors inside the panel, and uses a dedicated current audio-capable Gemini model for server transcription.
highlights: First toolbar tap opens 86Voice only; no microphone request or transcription occurs until Start Listening is pressed.
Voice failures remain visible in the 86Voice panel with a retry path and typed-command fallback.
Transcription defaults independently to gemini-3.5-flash-lite instead of inheriting a possibly legacy VOICE_GEMINI_MODEL.
Mobile browser coverage verifies that opening the panel causes zero microphone requests until Start Listening is pressed.
86Voice ignores stale Gemini 2.5 voice-only model overrides that are no longer available to newer API projects.
